definition: Gross domestic product divided by midyear population
price_ppp_basis: Constant 2015 prices; market-exchange-rate basis; not PPP
allowable_transformations: Ratios; percentage change; index with an explicitly named base year; log scale if labelled
rounding: Nearest whole dollar in labels; retain full precision for calculation
known_breaks_and_required_notes: Malaysia 1960 needs a territorial-construction note; 2020 is a pandemic year; do not mix with current US dollars or PPP series

unit: constant 2021 PPP international dollars per employed person
price_ppp_basis: Constant 2021 PPP; not market-exchange-rate US dollars
source_series: World Development Indicators / ILO modelled estimates
allowable_transformations: Ratios; percentage change between approved observations; index with named base
rounding: Nearest whole international dollar in labels; retain full precision
known_breaks_and_required_notes: No 1960 values; 1991 is the common +1 proxy for requested 1990; modelled inputs and pandemic endpoint; do not compare on GDP-per-capita dollar axis

definition: Employment in agriculture as a share of total employment under ILO sector definitions
source_series: World Development Indicators / ILO modelled estimates
allowable_transformations: Percentage-point difference; shares may be stacked with the other two approved sector series
rounding: For each country-actual-year three-sector composition: multiply full-precision source values by 10; floor each; allocate the remaining tenths needed to reach 1000 to the largest fractional remainders; break exact ties agriculture then industry then services; publish the separate display_value_1dp labels and retain value unchanged
known_breaks_and_required_notes: No harmonised 1960 values; 1991 is proxy for requested 1990; modelled estimates; do not splice historical census/livelihood categories

definition: Manufacturing value added divided by GDP
price_ppp_basis: Current-price share; not a constant-price volume index
allowable_transformations: Percentage-point difference; index only within the same approved series
known_breaks_and_required_notes: Ghana/Botswana use 1965 for requested 1960; Malaysia 1960 territorial note; Mauritius 1960 absent; Philippines 1960/1990 historical vintages excluded; current-price and pandemic composition effects

definition: People aged 15+ who can read and write a short simple statement with understanding
source_series: UNESCO UIS distributed through World Development Indicators
allowable_transformations: Percentage-point difference only among matched/caveated rows; no interpolation
known_breaks_and_required_notes: Partial panels only; source/method can differ by census or survey; literacy is not functional proficiency or learning quality

definition: Adults aged 15+ able to read and write; historical World Development Report table
allowable_transformations: Display only; no interpolation or trend connection to distant observations
known_breaks_and_required_notes: Table notes say labelled estimates may be up to two years from the label; use only as a visibly caveated 1960 observation

definition: People aged 15+ meeting Malaysia SDG 4.6.1 literacy definition
allowable_transformations: Display and percentage-point comparison only with explicit national-source note
known_breaks_and_required_notes: National LFS-based source rather than WDI/UIS; do not imply identical survey method

definition: Population living in areas classified as urban under national definitions harmonised/smoothed by the UN Population Division
source_series: World Development Indicators / UN Population Division
allowable_transformations: Percentage-point difference; index with explicit base if useful
known_breaks_and_required_notes: National definitions/boundaries differ and can change; Malaysia 1960 territorial note; urban share is not density or infrastructure quality

rounding: One decimal percentage point; display 100 without decimal if space requires
known_breaks_and_required_notes: No 1960 panel; 1990 panel uses actual years 1990/1991/1993 and omits Malaysia; access does not measure reliability; price; capacity; or industrial quality

definition: Perception-based composite of contract enforcement; property rights; police; courts; crime; and violence

definition: Product/category share of a stated merchandise-export FOB denominator
source_series: Country-specific historical; SITC; HS; PSCC; or principal-group sources
release_vintage: Multiple releases verified in country files
geographic_coverage: Reporter economy and source-specific trade coverage

rounding: One decimal only within the source-specific narrative
known_breaks_and_required_notes: Classifications; aggregation levels; periods; re-exports; and service coverage differ; no frozen chart rows

definition: Source-specific worker informality; informal-sector employment; self-employment; establishment informality; SME employment; or size-band outcome
release_vintage: Multiple releases verified in country files
allowable_transformations: No conversion between constructs; no residual inference
known_breaks_and_required_notes: Universes; age/sector coverage; size bands; registration/account criteria; and outcomes differ; no frozen chart rows

definition: Survey response to a named generalized or institution-specific trust question
source_series: Afrobarometer / Ipsos / World Values Survey source-specific questions
allowable_transformations: No cross-survey scale; no historical back-cast
rounding: Whole percentage point when source supports a weighted estimate
known_breaks_and_required_notes: Questions; institutions; weights; samples; and constructs differ; WVS Philippines value is unweighted cases; no frozen chart rows
